name: MES weekly-VWAP acceptance

rules.weekly_vwap_reset: Sunday 17:00 CT via futures trade-date week key; cumulative OHLCV typical-price VWAP
rules.time: at least 5 of last 6 completed 5m closes above developing wVWAP and last 3 consecutive above
rules.volume: at least 60% of last 12 completed bars' volume on bars whose typical price is above contemporaneous wVWAP, plus decision price above wVWAP
rules.developing_vpoc: uniformly distribute each elapsed RTH bar volume across crossed 0.25-point ticks; causal POC above wVWAP
rules.developing_tpo_poc: 30-minute completed-period TPO counts across 0.25-point ticks; causal POC above wVWAP
rules.clv_delta_proxy: sum(close-location-value*volume) over last 12 bars >0 and price>wVWAP; proxy only, NOT true bid/ask cumulative delta
rules.probabilities: trailing-only empirical class rates with symmetric Dirichlet alpha=1; minimum 60 prior sessions and 30 same-state sessions
rules.retain_rule: pooled paired block-bootstrap Brier CIs wholly >0 vs BOTH price>wVWAP and trailing unconditional baselines, Holm-adjusted one-sided p<=0.05 across 5x2 comparisons, higher net expectancy than price>wVWAP, and positive +1-tick stress expectancy

limitations: The continuous cache is stitched and not back-adjusted; a quarterly roll inside a week can distort developing weekly VWAP.
Developing VPOC is an OHLCV bar-range allocation proxy, not exchange volume-at-price.
CLV delta is not true bid/ask cumulative delta.
